title: George's father's death and the name George Lewis
summary: His father died when his son was an infant; George Lewis's name came from insurance trouble, and he was nicknamed George.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Sidney Bechet: the man, the horn, the legend

blocks.x: How old was George's father when he when he died? We were 10 years. How old was George?
Well Henry's dead now. My my grandson dead above Joseph. It's 34 years ago. Because he was under Joseph was under six months I believe when his grandfather died.
Yeah well when did George change his name to Lewis? When was that? Well I don't remember the year. I mean about how old was he? Was he playing

music then and changed it? Well he'd play at night you know. He was working on the river. And twice he got hurted on the river and didn't know. And he belonged to the national insurance. Yes.
